name: tier1_floor_route_onroute
_comment: ROUND 24 — A STATION SAMPLED FROM THE POLYLINE.
RULED (Rafe, 2026-08-30) after round 23's verdict was set aside as VOID-FOR-STATION rather
than negative: the seat judged ground whose ROUTE STRENGTH IS ZERO. It cited x 370-440,
y 250-430 as 'the corridor' and found nothing on it, correctly, because there is nothing on
it — the route at that height was over at x 151-279.
THE LAW: stations for traffic-keyed questions are SAMPLED FROM THE POLYLINE. The player
stands ON the route, the gameplay camera frames it, and the route AHEAD lies inside the lit
pool. A capture composed around the player's position is not composed around the route's
visible portion, and those stop being the same thing the moment the lamp is carried and the
TWO PRIOR ROUNDS WERE MIS-STATIONED and are recorded as such rather than as evidence:
ROUND 18  the chokepoint is one tile wide and has NO FLANK, so it could not answer a
contrast question however the floor was drawn.
ROUND 23  the approach station put the route's lit run off to one side while the
wall-announced corridor sat at the frame's bottom edge in the dark.
Geometry, carve list and mocked walls are IDENTICAL to tier1_floor_review.json — only the
player's station moves, so every comparison through that spec stays valid.

THIS STATION: room A, standing ON the route where it crosses the chamber. The route runs behind to (5,6) and ahead through (6,9) and (7,9) to the chokepoint mouth at (8,10), all inside the lit pool, and there is ordinary room floor on both flanks to contrast it against.
_legibility: Both points are ON THE ROUTE, which is the whole point of the station: the lit one is
route the seat must be able to read, and the dark one is route beyond the lamp, which
the design ruling accepts rather than fights.
Six tiles is the furthest declarable dark - seven lands at py 1026 against a view that
ends at 1001, and the probe refuses rather than measuring the letterbox.

legibility.why: on the route, inside the delivered pool - the ground the question is about
the same route past the lamp; dark illegibility accepted by design
